description: Connect your Leave account to find the right trip, summarize upcoming plans, check itinerary times and accommodation details, understand privacy-minimized budgets, expenses, and balances, find safe document metadata, review notes and tasks, and prepare approval-required trip changes. Leave remains the source of truth, and every request respects current trip membership, roles, scopes, and privacy rules.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my active trip and tell me what is coming up next.
Who do I owe money to on my active trip?
Draft a task for everyone on my active trip to check in online.
